---
title: Bibliographie
metadata-files: 
  - _common_fr.yml
---

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = F}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/Los_Angeles"))
load("_bibliography.RData")
print_bibliography <- .  %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(PDF, HTML, GitHub)) %>%  # render the <i> icons/links
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(PDF, HTML, GitHub)) %>%
  cols_width(
    PDF    ~ px(40),
    HTML   ~ px(40),
    GitHub ~ px(40),
    File ~ px(100)
  ) %>%
  opt_interactive(
    use_search       = T,
    use_resizers     = T,
    use_compact_mode = T
  )
```

# Français

```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
bibliography %>%
  filter(str_detect(File, "/fr/")) %>%
  print_bibliography()
```

# Anglais

```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
bibliography %>%
  filter(str_detect(File, "/en/")) %>%
  print_bibliography()
```


# Tous

```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
bibliography %>%
  print_bibliography()
```
